title: Level design
description: levels/<slug>/design.json: the authored source of a level (packages/service/design.py). The values under choices and intent are checked against the template's control catalog (design.capabilities), which this file does not restate: the catalog is read off the owning tools' code.
$comment: additionalProperties is true on purpose: a field this factory does not know is kept and reported to the designer as an unknown field, never dropped or refused.

design_id.description: Stable for the life of the design.

revision.description: +1 on every saved change; a save naming an older revision is refused.

name.description: The designer's name for the level.

slug.description: The name made safe for folders and mission ids, fixed at creation.

choices.description: Controls that change what is built (supported or conditional).

intent.description: Controls that are saved for the designer and review; nothing builds from them yet.
